title: Geography: Natural Vegetation Flashcards
description: Key facts from TNPSC Group II Geography Natural Vegetation Chapter

cards.q: What is the minimum annual rainfall required for Tropical Evergreen forests?
Which type of forest is characterized by a 'parkland landscape' with open stretches and trees shedding leaves completely in the dry season?
At what altitude are Chir Pine forests well-developed in the Himalayas?
What are the temperate forests in the higher regions of the Nilgiris, Anaimalai, and Palani hills called?
What percentage of the world's mangrove forests is found in India?
What is the term for species that are found only in some specific localized areas, such as the Andaman wild pig?
Approximately what percentage of the total number of species in the world is found in India?
In which year was the Indian Wildlife Protection Act enacted?
When was 'Project Tiger' launched in India?
What percentage of India's total forest land is classified as 'Reserved Forests'?
Which Indian state has the largest area under permanent forests?
Which environmental movement in the Himalayas successfully resisted deforestation and encouraged afforestation?
What term did Jawaharlal Nehru use to describe multi-purpose river projects and dams like Bhakra Nangal?
Which tribes practice transhumance in the Alpine pastures of the Himalayas (3,000-4,000m)?
What type of vegetation is found in the desert and semi-desert areas of Rajasthan?
cards.a: Cacti, a wide variety of bushes, and thorny vegetation (Tropical Thorn Forests).
